selection_rules.success: both_ok, r_minT closest to median of successes
selection_rules.evade_fail_strike: evade_ok & not strike_ok, prefer r_minT in [15.0,50.0]
selection_rules.type_b: only if all prior picks are type A; else skipped
selection_rules.type_b_def: not type A, and (all |a|>=0.99 or max std_n>=0.1)

field_notes.pos_*: stage2 only: N+1 x 3, [x,y,z] after reset then each step (inertial)
field_notes.pos_*_s3: stage3 PN traj (downsampled ~0.1s): M x 3; may be empty if intercepted
field_notes.a_M_body: stage2 N x 2, saturated lateral cmd [a_y, a_z] used by updateState
field_notes.a_M_inertial: stage2 N x 3, reconstructed inertial accel from (a_y,a_z,theta,psi,V)
field_notes.a_M_inertial_s3: stage3 M x 3, same reconstruction from PN a_M + att_M
field_notes.gamma_wT_wE: stage2 only N, physical weights via action_mapping
field_notes.t: stage2 N+1 (includes t=0); t_step length N aligns with actions/accel
field_notes.t_s3: stage3 times continuing from stage2 end (same clock as t)
field_notes.t_switch: stage2 end time; vertical marker between stage2 and stage3
field_notes.trajectory_scope: 3D/accel plots should stitch stage2 + stage3; actions remain stage2-only

selected.reason: requested but no type-B episode found in MC pool
